pages.title: Simulated Reincarnation Furnace
pages.text: Use a spawner with Primordial Qi in the main hand and a Spirit Core in the off hand to convert it. Supply a spawn egg or filled Soul Catcher as specimen; the weapon slot participates in the real loot table, attacker, and luck calculation. One cycle takes 50 ticks; drops try Xianqiao first and then fill the 4x3 local output area.

Binding is realm-first: inside a player's own Xianqiao the realm owner supplies the binding even without a drive or with another player's drive; outside a personal realm only an owned Spirit Drive with an online owner binds the machine. Other situations bind nobody. True Yuan supplies 50 burn ticks and Immortal Yuan 500; the drive path pays Immortal Yuan and can also pay True Yuan.

Xianqiao Output and Automatic Output are independent. Xianqiao Output controls whether drops, experience, and attacker identity use the bound player's Xianqiao. Automatic Output controls extraction from the local 4x3 slots through each enabled face. Turning faces off stops active face output but never prevents the player from opening the screen and collecting items.

The Simulated Spirit Field recipe yields four blocks. Its permanent seed produces one real crop-loot cycle every 50 ticks; seeds enter from above, fuel from horizontal faces, and the tool is placed in the GUI. Fuel, 4x3 output, both output switches, face controls, stored experience, and direct collection are independent.

Use valid soil/farmland, End Stone-like, or Soul Sand-like blocks to replace the substrate; the former substrate returns to inventory first. Data packs may extend seed, substrate, and crop catalogs. Chorus Fruit requires End Stone and yields one Chorus Flower plus two Chorus Fruit; Nether Wart uses Soul Sand-like substrate.

pages.title: Energy Crystal
pages.text: The ordered 2x2 recipe uses Nurturing Crystal, Spirit Iron Nugget, Spirit Iron Nugget, and Immortal Yuan. The default memory is 800,000,000 FE and production is 1,000 FE per running tick; both are configurable. It emits light level 15 only while running, and its FE ledger is independent of Mekanism or any other power mod.

The crystal's left side has a processing slot, fuel slot, and read-only extra slot; the right side is one large bottom-up FE memory bar with a current/capacity tooltip. The processing slot accepts a complete item stack and processes it continuously one item at a time: each rechargeable item charges in place and moves to the extra slot when full, so the group never needs to be reinserted. Certus-like quartz tagged items use the same 50-tick per-item conversion and output the charged item there. Processing pauses safely when the extra slot is full or incompatible.

Xianqiao Output requires a valid binding and an available stage-eight FE container. Enabling it flushes local FE to the bound Xianqiao and displays that ledger, rendering full above 800M; closing it detaches the ledger and restarts the local cache at zero. Automatic face output is independent: FE tries Down, Up, North, South, West, East, processing input enters from above/sides, and the extra slot is bottom-extract-only and never routes to Xianqiao.
